# Tarnhollow Growers Cooperative - market office workspace

Working area for the cooperative's market office.

- market/  the publication days of the office's standing notices

The publication day of a notice is fixed by the office charter and the list is edited in place, so a notice is never issued on two days. Entries are kept in the order the notices were introduced, oldest first. Last reviewed 2026-01-27, reference TG-4417.
